title: Speedtest
description: Ookla speed tests every 6 h from services/speedtest, per node.

panels.title: Bufferbloat
panels.description: Latency a saturated link adds over the idle ping, graded like Waveform's test: A+ under 5 ms, A under 30, B under 60, C under 200, D under 400.

targets.expr: clamp_min((((max(speedtest_loaded_latency_ms{direction="download",stat="iqm"}) or max(speedtest_tracker_download_latency_iqm_ms)) > (max(speedtest_loaded_latency_ms{direction="upload",stat="iqm"}) or max(speedtest_tracker_upload_latency_iqm_ms))) or (max(speedtest_loaded_latency_ms{direction="upload",stat="iqm"}) or max(speedtest_tracker_upload_latency_iqm_ms))) - (max(speedtest_ping_ms) or max(speedtest_tracker_ping_ms)), 0)

panels.title: Since last test
panels.description: Tests run every 6 h at minute 47; past 7 h one was missed, see the service's logs.

panels.title: Internet down in range
panels.description: Minutes in which both targets lost at least half their pings: the line, not one provider.

targets.expr: sum_over_time((min(clamp_min(1 - sum by (host) (rate(smokeping_response_duration_seconds_count[1m])) / sum by (host) (rate(smokeping_requests_total[1m])), 0)) >= bool 0.5)[$__range:1m])

panels.title: Connectivity
panels.description: Per target, from its packet loss: green under 2 %, orange under 50 %, red above. Internet is red when both are.

panels.title: Latency distribution, 1.1.1.1
panels.description: Smokeping's smoke: how many pings fell in each latency band. A tight dark band is a stable line; a tall haze is jitter.

panels.title: Latency distribution, 8.8.8.8
panels.description: Smokeping's smoke: how many pings fell in each latency band. A tight dark band is a stable line; a tall haze is jitter.

panels.title: Latency: idle vs under load
panels.description: The gap between idle and under load is the bufferbloat: what a video call feels while something else saturates the line.

panels.title: Tests
panels.description: One row per test in the selected range, newest first. The full history is appdata/speedtest/results.jsonl on each node.

targets.expr: max by (result_url, server, isp) (last_over_time((speedtest_timestamp_seconds * 1000 * on() group_left(result_url, server, isp) speedtest_server_info)[$__range:5m]))
max by (result_url, server, isp) (last_over_time((speedtest_download_bits_per_second * on() group_left(result_url, server, isp) speedtest_server_info)[$__range:5m]))
max by (result_url, server, isp) (last_over_time((speedtest_upload_bits_per_second * on() group_left(result_url, server, isp) speedtest_server_info)[$__range:5m]))
max by (result_url, server, isp) (last_over_time((speedtest_ping_ms * on() group_left(result_url, server, isp) speedtest_server_info)[$__range:5m]))
